entities.summary: Republic of the Congo is a sovereign nation in Central Africa, Africa. Its capital is Brazzaville. Official languages include French. Government: Unitary dominant-party presidential republic. Population: approximately 6.1 million. Area: 342,000 km². Comprehensive index for the Republic of the Congo (Congo-Brazzaville) covering early Bantu settlement, Kongo Kingdom, Teke Kingdom, French Congo and French Equatorial Africa, Congo-Ocean Railway forced labour, independence, Marxist period, Sassou-Nguesso, civil wars, and oil economy.
